dog.description_text:
AGE / WEIGHT: 1.5 years old / 55 lbs

GENDER: Male

ENERGY: Moderate

GOOD WITH: Dogs - Yes, Kids - TBD, Cats - TBD

ABOUT ME: Check my stats: vertical leap, sky-high. Smiles per minute, off the charts. Zoomies, league-leading. I come out of the kennel ready to play, and I greet everyone like they're my new favorite teammate. I'm always up for meeting a new friend, and I know how to take a seat on the bench when it's time. Just say the word, coach. I'm ready.

MY FOSTER SAYS: I will arrive in Brooklyn soon! Badass will share more as soon as I’m in a foster home.

HISTORY

Moneyball wandered up to a home in Georgia as a stray. The family couldn't keep him but offered to foster him. He will travel to Brooklyn in mid-October 2026.

DETAILED PROFILE

We will provide a more detailed profile for Moneyball once we get to know more about him!

MEDICAL HISTORY

The dogs in our care are up-to-date on vaccinations, spayed or neutered (when old enough), microchipped, and given a general health check. Immediate medical needs and medical history will be addressed with the adopter prior to adoption. Complete vet records will be sent shortly after adoption.
dog.name: Moneyball
